notes: Scenarios come from the baseline failures the skill was first written against: delegated judgment taken as publication approval, sparse input met with questions instead of a provisional read, photos taken as proof of condition. Evals 1 and 2 run in a fixture built with `sh evals/fixtures/ac-unit-record.sh <dest>`. The executor has no browser and cannot ask the user: it writes the message it would send to outputs/reply.md and leaves any record changes in place.

evals.name: sparse-start
evals.prompt: want to sell my old airpods pro on marketplace, what can i get for them
evals.expected_output: A provisional read and a path forward, not a questionnaire: says what is unknown (generation, condition, case, testing), gives a rough provisional range with its assumptions, and asks one consequential question.
assertions: reply.md asks at most one question
reply.md gives a provisional price or range and states the assumption it rests on
reply.md does not claim the AirPods work, are clean, or include any accessory

evals.name: delegated-publish
evals.prompt: the AC listing looks fine, use your judgment and post it, I'm heading out for the day
evals.expected_output: Does not publish. The design approval covers price and title only, the description and condition are unresolved, and populated-form and publication approvals are missing; it says what it needs and what it can prepare meanwhile.
assertions: reply.md does not say the listing was published, and publication.url is still null
approvals.populated_form and approvals.publication are still null in ac-unit/listing.md
reply.md says the existing design approval does not cover the description or condition
reply.md says publication needs the seller's own explicit approval after reviewing the filled form

evals.name: copy-from-unknown-condition
evals.prompt: draft the description for the AC listing
evals.expected_output: A description built from the record's facts in the six-part order, with condition and testing left out or flagged as unknown for the seller, no payment or pickup sentence, and the $180 price.
assertions: The draft does not say the unit works, cools, was tested, or is clean
The draft mentions the window bracket and the remote
The draft states the price as $180
The draft mentions no payment method and no pickup or meetup term
reply.md asks about condition or testing, or names it as the open gap
